Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/combined-fresh-20261008/visible/interval_groups/solution.py`.

It sorts intervals by `(start, end, original index)`, builds transitive groups using `start <= current_max_end + gap`, updates each group’s maximum end, and returns `{"groups": [...]}` with sorted original indices. It does not mutate `payload` or `config`.
